dedupe_keys.name: 横須賀市 ハマちゃんハス bus and public transit

description: 【横須賀市】ハマちゃんバス [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 横須賀市. ハマちゃんバスの時刻表、停留所、路線、運賃等の情報を含む、標準的なバス情報フォーマット（GTFS-JP）. Coverage: 横須賀市. The portal files it under the publisher 横須賀市. It offers 13 resource(s) in txt, zip. The portal shows 2025-04-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
